item.description:
The notch folds into the Mac's own cutout and joins it as one liquid shape, menu bar bars, a font size setting, and Korean, Ukrainian and Chinese brought up to date.

  • One with the camera notch: folded, the notch is exactly the Mac's own cutout; dragged onto it, it joins as one shape that stretches across the camera, with no gaps or cut-off ends in screenshots. It stays open while a session is active.
  • Menu bar indicators: usage as bars in the menu bar, coloured by your Watch and Critical settings.
  • Font size: larger, more legible text in the notch and its cards.
  • A deficit marker on the ring, and a ring that shuts once a monthly allowance is spent.
  • MiMo's Token Plan, DeepSeek's balance with an API key, OpenCode Go, several codex-auth accounts, Codex weekly limits on prolite plans, MiniMax China, Claude Code from npm, and Manual's own icon.
  • 한국어, Українська and 简体中文 are up to date.
  • Windows: Mistral, Cursor's sealed session and weekly allowance, Claude sign-ins that ask again when they can no longer renew, hooks that never start the app, and a reset card that follows the taskbar strip.
